science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The First Forge hummed with the electric resonance of the twin suns, casting amber and violet hues across the polished copper bulkheads. Silas meticulously wiped a smudge of crystallized ozone from the primary containment vessel, the sharp scent of ionized air mingling with the deep, grounding aroma of hot iron. He could hear the low, rhythmic thrum of the magnetosphere fighting the ferrofluid sea outside, sending a faint vibration through the floorplates that he felt all the way to his teeth. He adjusted the final brass valve to seal the chamber. 'Inefficient,' he muttered affectionately, comparing the current draw against the latest storm data. Turning from the main console, he picked up the heavy, warm copper calibration baton and held it out, explicitly handing it into Hector's waiting hands to continue the sequence.
